description:
Check YES and NO share balances for an address in a Stacks Market prediction market.

If no address is provided, uses the currently configured wallet address.
No wallet required when an address is explicitly supplied.

Note: Stacks Market is only available on mainnet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: Stacks address to check position for. Uses configured wallet if not provided.

name: stacks_market_get_position
